description.zh: 将本来可读的文本转换为另一种可读（存疑）的英语文本的神秘编码。
description.en: Convert text to binary, using 'that he thinks' for 0 and 'that she thinks' for 1, starting with 'I think' and ending with 'me.' to form recursive thought chains

description.zh: 每位的连接方式：空格、逗号、或直接连接
description.en: How to connect each bit: space, comma, or direct concatenation

description.zh: 每个字符的二进制位数（8或16）

encode: function(input, params) { var sep = params.separator || 'space'; var bitLen = params.binaryLength || 8; var separatorMap = { 'space': ' ', 'comma': ', ', 'none': '' }; var separator = separatorMap[sep] || ' '; var binaryStr = ''; for (var i = 0; i < input.length; i++) { var code = input.charCodeAt(i); var bin = code.toString(2); while (bin.length < bitLen) { bin = '0' + bin; } binaryStr += bin; } var result = 'I think '; for (var i = 0; i < binaryStr.length; i++) { if (binaryStr[i] === '0') { result += 'that he thinks'; } else { result += 'that she thinks'; } if (i < binaryStr.length - 1) { result += separator; } } result += ' me.'; return result; }
decode: function(input, params) { var bitLen = params.binaryLength || 8; var clean = input.replace(/^I think\s*/, '').replace(/\s*me\.$/, ''); var parts = clean.split(/\s*,\s*|\s+/); var binaryStr = ''; for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { var token = parts[i].trim(); if (token === 'that' && parts[i+1] === 'he' && parts[i+2] === 'thinks') { binaryStr += '0'; i += 2; } else if (token === 'that' && parts[i+1] === 'she' && parts[i+2] === 'thinks') { binaryStr += '1'; i += 2; } } var result = ''; for (var i = 0; i < binaryStr.length; i += bitLen) { if (i + bitLen <= binaryStr.length) { var byte = binaryStr.substr(i, bitLen); var code = parseInt(byte, 2); result += String.fromCharCode(code); } } return result; }
